conclusion.statement: The predictor-corrector preserved diverted topology and finite X points on every frame and traversed more Newton-step-equivalents than paired backtracking, but admitted fewer advances and ended with a higher residual on four of five frames. It is therefore a topology-preserving negative rather than a convergence result. No threshold is derived from the observed values.
